content.title: Coachella Music Festival 2026 | Music Festival Wizard
content.text: The Scene Like a barometer always reading a temperature of awesome, the traditional kickoff to the summer festival season is dominated by Coachella. The glitz and glamour of Los Angeles migrates east to the Indio desert for back to back weekends of the biggest names in music. What started as a small electronic festival in the desert has transformed into a cultural touchstone for the festival season. - Copyright Music Festival Wizard Frequently Asked Questions What are the dates of Coachella Music Festival 2026? This year, the event will be held from April 10-19, 2026. What is the age minimum? This event is all ages. Check the official website for additional restrictions. Where is this festival held? Coachella Music Festival 2026 takes place at Empire Polo Club in Indio, CA. View on Google Maps here. Does this festival offer camping? Yes! You can camp at Coachella Music Festival 2026. Make sure to check out our ultimate fest camping checklist for supplies.Does this festival allow RV camping? As far as we know, this event is tent camping only. Where can I buy tickets for Coachella Music Festival 2026? You can purchase tickets for the event here.
